name: Vent gateway
ownerWords:
is Vent fully implemented and functioning rn? make it so it is. follow the original proposal discussion, all external API/webhook should pass here, we should be tracking OTEL ...

completely remove all legacy sdk, API keys from old deployments.

10-19: ACTUALLY remove all the direct API keys from all apps
goal: Every in-scope outside API call site and inbound webhook goes through Vent in prod, with GeoNode proxy egress the one allowed exception, and no deployment other than Vent holds a provider key, except the Slack token the alarm fallback keeps. On 10-19 the intent audit moved call success and host health to the duty Vent integrations, so this duty holds the cutover and the keys. Two problems kept coming back here: key copies left in old places (.bak files on us-metal01, the old Railway vent service, research-agent-be tier files, expired Instagram copies), which provider_keys_outside_vent counts, and direct provider calls showing up again at main outside the inventory (search's old PostHog client, 28 unlisted files on 10-19), which the new_direct_site rows show. Since 10-19 the call-site list comes from the code at the dev/sieun tip, so a site whose call the tip removed leaves the count and a new direct call there counts. Since 10-22 it also holds goal p22's removals: removed_provider_refs fails when code, a test or a Vent integration of a removed provider comes back at the tip. Since 10-22 no_prod_traffic_sites is a number the precheck shows with no target, because whether customers connect a provider is demand and the owner asked only that every call goes through Vent (c67); on 10-22 it read 3 (Notion, Telegram, the Slack incoming webhook) while each of the three reached its provider through prod Vent and got the provider's own auth error. Since 10-27 it also reads test_calls_real_24h, the number of goal p85, as a reading with no target here (owner rule c174, "these shouldn't be actually being sent"): the Resend and Gmail sends, Langfuse trace exports and Slack sales pings that Vent on staging, CI or a local box sent a real provider in 24 h instead of answering from its fake, without the mail checks' sends to their own real sinks mailsink.virev.ai and nomail.virev.ai. Stripe stays out, because its staging calls run in test mode and the billing and card checks keep them real on purpose.

metrics.label: In-scope call sites and webhooks whose code at main goes through Vent with no direct call
Provider keys still held by deployments other than Vent
Files at the dev/sieun tip that name a provider p22 removed, outside the kept guards, plus removed Vent integrations listed again

readings.label: Test sends off production (Resend, Gmail, Langfuse trace export, Slack sales) that reached the real provider in 24 h, the number of goal p85 (target 0)

onMiss: Read the flagged rows and steer the live job that owns each one, or start one fix job when none is live, with the metric's name in its brief. site_direct and tip_site_direct rows go to the p8 job 'vent cutover train' by app, and webhook_direct rows go to the p4 job 'vent webhooks'; a site counts only once its code is on main, which prod runs. A site_removed row needs no action: the tip removed that call, so it left the count, and prod drops it at the next promote. A no_prod_traffic row (the no_prod_traffic_sites number, shown with no target) means the code at main calls Vent but prod Vent logged no successful vent.call for it in 7 days, usually because no customer uses that provider yet; it still counts as through (owner rule c67) and needs no fix step. Check the caller's VENT_URL and VENT_KEY in prod only when the site also shows prod errors. A new_direct_site row is a direct provider call at the tip that no inventory row covers, and it counts as a direct site until the p8 job moves it to Vent. vent-share.py takes Vent's integrations from apps/vent/src/vent/tables.py, so a provider with no integration there needs one in Vent. provider_keys_outside_vent above 0: each key_outside_vent row names a location and key names, and the p3 job 'vent cutover train' removes a key once no caller there reads it, .bak copies on us-metal01 included. Never print or copy a key value. removed_provider_refs above 0: each removed_provider_ref row names a provider goal p22 removed to the root (the old konti.bot media stack and research app, our own Meta Graph app, ZeroBounce and the Vent integrations no live code called) and the file at the dev/sieun tip, or the tables.py integration, that names it again. Start one fix job that deletes that code, test or Vent row through the auto-sns-agent git workflow skill, with the metric's name in its brief, and put its fix step under p22. A row that is a real guard which keeps the provider out, such as a new ban list or a drop migration's test, goes into KEPT_GUARDS in vent-gateway.ts with its reason instead. A source_error row means a source was not read, so fix the read before trusting the number. No outside sends (c37). Jobs land to staging on their own and leave prod promotes to the release owner, who walks each one with the owner (c154); only crawler, observability dashboard and demo.virev.ai deploys ship to prod without him. A step that waits on the owner's answer to a prod deploy todo is waiting on him under owner rule c154 (agents end at staging, prod Vent deploys are walked with the owner); never suggest shipping it without his answer. All on target: end the turn with no message. test_calls_real_24h above 0: read the test_send_real rows. A row whose caller and method a test-target rule should fake (vent/mock/targets.py, a fake's test_target, or test_off_production in tables.py) goes to the p85 job 'vent test target fakes' as a fake to add or fix; a row from code that has not reached staging yet needs no action until the next land.
